description: Upkeep phase with an 'at the beginning of your upkeep' triggered ability source on the battlefield; empty stack. Core + delayed-trigger + battlefield buckets (no stack bucket). System 3 should surface triggered-ability/upkeep rules. REQ-179: rule 603.3b is a lettered sub-rule of curated topic abilities-trigger-basics' rule 603.3, so System 3's rule-number-prefix exclusion now correctly omits it from supplemental (a curated parent excludes its own children) instead of letting a related rule number reappear; 603.3b was hand-dropped from the expected supplemental set rather than chased in the scorer.

request.question: It's my upkeep. My Phyrexian Arena's beginning-of-upkeep trigger and my opponent's beginning-of-upkeep trigger both want to go on the stack — who chooses the order and when do they trigger?

battlefield.name: Phyrexian Arena
battlefield.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
